scripts.text:
[Temporary Dimension-mover]
Do you not have a companion to join you? Organize your party even if traveling alone.
scripts.translation:
[臨時次元移動器]
沒有同伴與您同行嗎？即使獨自前往，也請先組建隊伍。

scripts.text:
[Temporary Dimension-mover]
The passage for dimensional moving has not been vitalized.
scripts.translation:
[臨時次元移動器]
次元移動通道尚未啟用。

scripts.text:
[Temporary Dimension-mov]
Unknown Error.
scripts.translation:
[臨時次元移動器]
未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Temporary Dimension-mover]
There are remaining traces of the last event. Access denied.
scripts.translation:
[臨時次元移動器]
檢測到上次行動的殘留痕跡，無法進入。

scripts.text: ^0000ffUse of Dimension-mover seems possible.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff似乎可以使用次元移動器。^000000

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Well... I don't know if you can come in handy, it seems that there is still a gap!
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
嗯...不知道您能不能幫上忙，實力似乎還差了一點！

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
When you become stronger, come back to me. You should be almost level 135!
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
等實力更強些再來找我吧，至少得有135級左右才行！

scripts.text: ^ff0000Taming monsters will impede progress in this dungeon. Please take note of this.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000馴服魔物會阻礙此副本的進度。請注意這一點。^000000

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
There are a lot of interesting things about the ancient civilizations in this area.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
這個地區的古代文明有很多有趣的地方。

scripts.text: [Civilization Explorer]
scripts.translation: [文明探索者]

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
How can I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
What do you want to do this time?
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
這次您想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Observing the soil strata it is estimated to be 500 to 600 years old!
But many of the excavated objects here already far surpass our current technology.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
從地層判斷，這裡大約有五六百年的歷史！
但這裡出土的許多東西，技術水平早已遠超我們現在。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
A lot of undefined terms are found in the recovered records as well.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
在找回的記錄裡，也發現了許多含義不明的術語。

scripts.text: What kind of unknown terms?
scripts.translation: 什麼含義不明的術語？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
^0000ffMother Computer^000000 or, ^0000ff LSI Chip^000000 Or, and what else. ^0000ffChicken^000000?
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
^0000ff主控電腦^000000、^0000ff大規模積體電路晶片^000000，還有什麼來著...^0000ff雞^000000？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Mm that's right. There definitely was the word Chicken. I don't know what kind of combination of technology that may be...
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
嗯，沒錯，裡面確實有“雞”這個詞。
真不知道這是哪幾種技術的組合...

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
It is referrenced in the records of people who seem to 'root' amongst the many traces of technology.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
記錄中提到，似乎有人在眾多技術痕跡中“紮根”。

scripts.text: It is not a topic I would be interested in.
scripts.translation: 這不是我感興趣的話題

scripts.text: Interesting. Have there been any results?
scripts.translation: 有趣。有什麼結果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Unfortunate.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
My aim is to research the use of technology related to the relevant times. Even though what I have found out so far is insignificant.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
我想研究那個時代的技術是如何應用的，可目前的發現還微不足道。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
If I had it my way I would use the dimension mover to see for myself but there's too much work. Besides I am not an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
我倒想用次元移動器親自去看看，可手頭的工作太多了。
再說，我也不是冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
By any chance, would you interested in traveling to the past?
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
不知您是否有興趣前往過去？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Even better if you show me around if you find an interesting object.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
要是發現了什麼有趣的東西，能帶來給我看看就更好了。

scripts.text: Not interested.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text: Ok.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Unfortunate.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
You are an adventurer. Tell me what you decide to do.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
您是冒險者。請告訴我您的決定。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Please talk to me after composing a party of 1 or more, or after joining a party.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
請組建一支至少1人的隊伍，或加入一支隊伍後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Ah. You aren't the party leader. Take me to your leader! Or perhaps take your leader to me.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
啊，您不是隊長。
帶我去見隊長吧！或者請隊長來見我也行。

scripts.text: Produce a crack of time
scripts.translation: 製造時間裂縫

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
When the crack of time opens take a breath and speak again.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
等時間裂縫開啟後，稍作休息，再來和我說話吧。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Explorer]
Ah, oh no.
There are some remaining aftereffects of dimensional travel. We cannot travel again in this condition.
scripts.translation:
[文明探索者]
啊，糟糕。
上次次元旅行的影響還沒消退，這種狀態下無法再次出發。

scripts.text: ^0000ffAll the traces of entering the central laboratory have been erased. Speaking with the Civilization Explorer seems possible.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff進入中央實驗室的痕跡已被抹去。似乎可以與文明探索者對話。^000000

scripts.text:
[Probationary researcher]
The entrance door is already open.
scripts.translation:
[試用期研究員]
入口的門已經打開了。

scripts.text:
[Probationary researcher]
Please hold. I am speaking with the guide about whether or not you have been authorized.
scripts.translation:
[試用期研究員]
請稍等，我正在與嚮導確認您是否獲得了進入許可。

scripts.text:
[Probationary researcher]
Are you participating as assistants to the experiments of research project 32001?
scripts.translation:
[試用期研究員]
您是來協助研究專案32001的實驗的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Probationary researcher]
It seems you're in the wrong laboratory. Please exit and ask for help.
scripts.translation:
[試用期研究員]
看來您走錯實驗室了。請出去尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Probationary researcher]
We need about 5 seconds of time. Confirming access code.
scripts.translation:
[試用期研究員]
正在核對通行密碼，請等5秒鐘左右。

scripts.text:
[Switch {0}]
The switch is currently in the {1} position. What will you do?
scripts.translation:
[開關 {0}]
開關當前處於{1}位置。您打算怎麼做？

scripts.text: ON
scripts.translation: 開啟

scripts.text: OFF
scripts.translation: 關閉

scripts.text:
[Senior Researcher]
The door is open so you may now enter. Please note that you cannot open the door from the other side.
scripts.translation:
[高階研究員]
門已經打開了，您可以進去了。請注意，您無法從另一側開啟這扇門。

scripts.text:
[Senior Researcher]
It seems you are here to participate in the particle acceleration experiment.
scripts.translation:
[高階研究員]
看來您是來參加粒子加速實驗的。

scripts.text:
[Senior Researcher]
Today's access code is ^0000ff{0}^000000.
The code needs to be entered as a binary number. Use the switches behind me to enter it.
scripts.translation:
[高階研究員]
今天的通行密碼是^0000ff{0}^000000。
請將密碼轉換為二進位制，再用我身後的開關輸入。

scripts.text:
[Senior Researcher]
After entering the code press the main button near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[高階研究員]
輸入程式碼後，請按下入口附近的主按鈕。

scripts.text:
[DR Silvia]
After the experiment I want to go home and enjoy an ice cold beer and some fried chicken.
scripts.translation:
[西爾維婭博士]
實驗結束後，我想回家喝杯冰鎮啤酒，吃點炸雞。

scripts.text:
[DR Silvia]
I haven't been home for almost 2 years.
scripts.translation:
[西爾維婭博士]
我已經快兩年沒回家了。

scripts.text: ^0000ffSilvia is looking at the particle accelerator device with a very exhausted look.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff西爾維婭正用極其疲憊的眼神看著粒子加速器。^000000

scripts.text:
[DR Federico]
This device is more amazing the more I look at. There has never been a particle accelerator made in this scale.
scripts.translation:
[費德里科博士]
這臺裝置越看越令人驚歎。從未有過如此規模的粒子加速器。

scripts.text:
[DR Federico]
With this size I wonder if it's possible to create a small scale black hole...
scripts.translation:
[費德里科博士]
這麼大的裝置，不知道能不能製造出一個小型黑洞...

scripts.text:
[DR Federico]
Ah, I was just talking. Such an event is closer to a disaster than an experiment haha.
scripts.translation:
[費德里科博士]
啊，我只是隨口說說。
真發生那種事，可就成災難了，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[DR Artemia]
Look, reality doesn't like it when you grab a piece of string and give it a tug.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾特米婭博士]
你看，現實可經不起你拽著線頭隨意拉扯。

scripts.text:
[DR Artemia]
A dimensional distortion can happen with such a powerful particle acceleration.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾特米婭博士]
如此強大的粒子加速可能會導致次元扭曲。

scripts.text:
[DR Artemia]
I have a bad feeling about this because... Nature finds a way.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾特米婭博士]
我對這件事有種不好的預感，因為...大自然總會找到出路。

scripts.text:
[DR Vincent]
The machine is perfect. Nothing will go wrong!
scripts.translation:
[文森特博士]
機器是完美的。什麼都不會出錯！

scripts.text:
[DR Vincent]
Artemia worries too much. Anyway I'm going on a trip after the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[文森特博士]
阿爾特米婭太愛操心了。總之，實驗結束後我要去旅行了。

scripts.text:
[Time Administrator]
Which time do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[時間管理員]
您想去哪個時間點？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: 1 start
scripts.translation: 1號起點

scripts.text: 2 start
scripts.translation: 2號起點

scripts.text: 3 start
scripts.translation: 3號起點

scripts.text: 4 start
scripts.translation: 4號起點

scripts.text:
[Laboratory Administrator]
All handled well!
scripts.translation:
[實驗室管理員]
一切處理妥當！
